item_name: Rothco Heavyweight Canvas Platoon Tool Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Heavyweight Canvas Platoon Tool Bag is the ideal solution for carrying and organizing your tools. Constructed from durable heavyweight cotton canvas, this tool equipment bag is designed to withstand the rigors of heavy use. The bag measures 11 inch x 10 inch x 9 inch, providing ample space for a variety of tools and accessories. Featuring a reliable polyester zipper closure, your tools will remain securely stored inside the canvas bag. The sturdy carry handles ensure easy and comfortable transportation.
